objective: Gate 3A de EDARSAHUB Services. Auditar exclusivamente el esquema fisico SQL existente necesario para convertir el Domain Data Contract certificado de Gate 2 en un Physical Schema & DDL Dossier seguro. Resolver tipos reales de PK/FK, naming, columnas de auditoria, indices, constraints y colisiones para Gobierno Persona, Clientes, Proveedores, RBAC, Documentos, COA/Comisiones, ActivoFijo/OrdenesTrabajo, Inventarios/Materiales, Produccion/Tablajeria y candidatos existentes de Services/Construction/Fabrication/Interiors/Land/Notaria. No DDL, no DML, no EXEC, no cambios de archivos y no Production.
constraints: SQL Server EDARSAHUB es la fuente canonica
No crear objetos nuevos en este gate
No tocar backend/core, Scheduler, NetPay ni Production
No asumir tipos de PK/FK: medirlos
Gate3B dependera de esta evidencia antes de proponer DDL

queries.name: SVC_G3A_00_IDENTITY
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name, USER_NAME() AS database_user;

queries.name: SVC_G3A_01_EXACT_CANONICAL_OBJECTS
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,o.create_date,o.modify_date FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (o.name IN ('Gobierno_Persona','Gobierno_PersonaVinculo','Gobierno_Documento','Gobierno_DocumentoVersion','Cliente_Catalogo','Cliente_Contactos','Cliente_Direcciones','Proveedor_Catalogo','Usuario_Catalogo','Usuario_EmpresasAsignacion','Usuario_AlmacenesAsignacion','Usuario_SucursalesAsignacion','Usuario_RolesAsignacion','Usuario_RolesContexto','Sistema_RBAC_Permisos','Sistema_RBAC_Roles','Sistema_RBAC_RolesPermisos','COA_Expedientes','COA_ExpedienteEventos','COA_ExpedienteReferencias','COA_ReglasComision','COA_ReglasComisionCondiciones','COA_ComisionAplicada','ActivoFijo_Activos','ActivoFijo_OrdenesTrabajo','ActivoFijo_OrdenTrabajoCostos','ActivoFijo_PlanesMantenimiento','Venta_Cotizaciones','Venta_Pedidos','CRM_Leads','CRM_Oportunidades','Sistema_Empresas','Sistema_Sucursales','Unidades_Negocio')) ORDER BY s.name,o.name;

queries.name: SVC_G3A_02_EXACT_COLUMNS_TYPES
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity,dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.object_id=c.default_object_id WHERE t.name IN ('Gobierno_Persona','Gobierno_PersonaVinculo','Gobierno_Documento','Gobierno_DocumentoVersion','Cliente_Catalogo','Cliente_Contactos','Cliente_Direcciones','Proveedor_Catalogo','Usuario_Catalogo','Usuario_EmpresasAsignacion','Usuario_AlmacenesAsignacion','Usuario_SucursalesAsignacion','Usuario_RolesAsignacion','Usuario_RolesContexto','Sistema_RBAC_Permisos','Sistema_RBAC_Roles','Sistema_RBAC_RolesPermisos','COA_Expedientes','COA_ExpedienteEventos','COA_ExpedienteReferencias','COA_ReglasComision','COA_ReglasComisionCondiciones','COA_ComisionAplicada','ActivoFijo_Activos','ActivoFijo_OrdenesTrabajo','ActivoFijo_OrdenTrabajoCostos','ActivoFijo_PlanesMantenimiento','Venta_Cotizaciones','Venta_Pedidos','CRM_Leads','CRM_Oportunidades','Sistema_Empresas','Sistema_Sucursales','Unidades_Negocio') ORDER BY s.name,t.name,c.column_id;

queries.name: SVC_G3A_03_PK_UQ_INDEXES
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,i.name AS index_name,i.is_primary_key,i.is_unique,i.type_desc,c.name AS column_name,ic.key_ordinal,ic.is_included_column FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.index_id>0 AND t.name IN ('Gobierno_Persona','Gobierno_PersonaVinculo','Gobierno_Documento','Cliente_Catalogo','Proveedor_Catalogo','Usuario_Catalogo','COA_ReglasComision','COA_ReglasComisionCondiciones','COA_ComisionAplicada','ActivoFijo_Activos','ActivoFijo_OrdenesTrabajo','ActivoFijo_OrdenTrabajoCostos','Sistema_Empresas','Sistema_Sucursales','Unidades_Negocio') ORDER BY s.name,t.name,i.index_id,ic.key_ordinal,ic.index_column_id;

queries.name: SVC_G3A_04_FOREIGN_KEYS_EXACT
queries.sql: SELECT schp.name AS parent_schema,tp.name AS parent_table,cp.name AS parent_column,fk.name AS fk_name,schr.name AS referenced_schema,tr.name AS referenced_table,cr.name AS referenced_column,fk.delete_referential_action_desc,fk.update_referential_action_desc FROM sys.foreign_key_columns fkc JOIN sys.foreign_keys fk ON fk.object_id=fkc.constraint_object_id JOIN sys.tables tp ON tp.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas schp ON schp.schema_id=tp.schema_id JOIN sys.columns cp ON cp.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND cp.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.tables tr ON tr.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.schemas schr ON schr.schema_id=tr.schema_id JOIN sys.columns cr ON cr.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND cr.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE tp.name IN ('Gobierno_PersonaVinculo','Gobierno_DocumentoVersion','Cliente_Contactos','Cliente_Direcciones','Usuario_EmpresasAsignacion','Usuario_AlmacenesAsignacion','Usuario_SucursalesAsignacion','Usuario_RolesAsignacion','Usuario_RolesContexto','COA_Expedientes','COA_ExpedienteEventos','COA_ExpedienteReferencias','COA_ReglasComision','COA_ReglasComisionCondiciones','COA_ComisionAplicada','ActivoFijo_OrdenesTrabajo','ActivoFijo_OrdenTrabajoCostos','Venta_Cotizaciones','Venta_Pedidos') OR tr.name IN ('Gobierno_Persona','Cliente_Catalogo','Proveedor_Catalogo','Usuario_Catalogo','Sistema_Empresas','Sistema_Sucursales','Unidades_Negocio') ORDER BY schp.name,tp.name,fk.name,cp.name;

queries.name: SVC_G3A_05_AUDIT_STATUS_DATE_PATTERNS
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (3000) s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%created%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%creado%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%updated%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%actualizado%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%usuario%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%estatus%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%estado%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%fechaoper%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%fecha_oper%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%vigencia%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%version%') AND (LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%gobierno%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%coa_%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%activofijo%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%cliente%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%proveedor%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%usuario%') ORDER BY s.name,t.name,c.column_id;

queries.name: SVC_G3A_06_INVENTORY_PRODUCTION_TABLAJERIA
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (2500) s.name AS schema_name,o.type_desc,o.name AS object_name FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND o.type IN ('U','V','P','FN','IF','TF') AND (LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%invent%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%almacen%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%material%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%insumo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%produ%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%tablaj%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%bom%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%corte%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%merma%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%despiece%') ORDER BY s.name,o.type_desc,o.name;

queries.name: SVC_G3A_07_LAND_REAL_ESTATE_NOTARY_COLLISIONS
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (2500) s.name AS schema_name,o.type_desc,o.name AS object_name FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND o.type IN ('U','V','P','FN','IF','TF') AND (LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%inmueble%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%predio%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%terreno%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%parcela%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%lote%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%sublote%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%manzana%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%fraccion%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%catastr%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%escritura%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%notari%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%registro%public%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%promesa%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%apartado%') ORDER BY s.name,o.type_desc,o.name;

queries.name: SVC_G3A_08_SERVICES_CONSTRUCTION_INTERIORS_COLLISIONS
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (2500) s.name AS schema_name,o.type_desc,o.name AS object_name FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND o.type IN ('U','V','P','FN','IF','TF') AND (LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%servicio%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%prestador%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%especialidad%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%credencial%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%cita%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%agenda%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%proyecto%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%obra%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%cuadrilla%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%estimacion%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%avance%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%constru%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%interior%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%espacio%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%moodboard%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%layout%') ORDER BY s.name,o.type_desc,o.name;

queries.name: SVC_G3A_09_CHECK_CONSTRAINTS
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (3000) s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,cc.name AS constraint_name,cc.definition FROM sys.check_constraints cc JOIN sys.tables t ON t.object_id=cc.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id WHERE t.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%coa_%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%activofijo%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%gobierno%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%cliente%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%proveedor%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%usuario%') ORDER BY s.name,t.name,cc.name;

queries.name: SVC_G3A_10_ROWCOUNTS_REFERENCE
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,SUM(CASE WHEN p.index_id IN (0,1) THEN p.rows ELSE 0 END) AS approx_rows FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id LEFT JOIN sys.partitions p ON p.object_id=t.object_id WHERE t.name IN ('Gobierno_Persona','Gobierno_PersonaVinculo','Gobierno_Documento','Cliente_Catalogo','Proveedor_Catalogo','Usuario_Catalogo','COA_Expedientes','COA_ReglasComision','COA_ReglasComisionCondiciones','COA_ComisionAplicada','ActivoFijo_Activos','ActivoFijo_OrdenesTrabajo','ActivoFijo_OrdenTrabajoCostos','Venta_Cotizaciones','Venta_Pedidos','CRM_Leads','CRM_Oportunidades') GROUP BY s.name,t.name ORDER BY s.name,t.name;
